players.product: Hyperscale data centers in China leased under binding take-or-pay commitments to China's largest hyperscalers and emerging AI companies (established tier-1 markets plus new campuses in Ulanqab and Horinger, Inner Mongolia, Shaoguan, Guangdong, and Zhongwei, Ningxia)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration (20-F, customers not named): two customers generated 29.0% and 12.0% of total net revenue in 2025 (29.0% and 14.4% in 2024; 28.3% and 17.1% in 2023); no other customer accounted for 10% or more. As of December 31, 2025 the two largest customers accounted for 37.9% and 11.8% of total area committed; the top five customers, all cloud service providers or large internet companies, held 37.9%, 11.8%, 8.8%, 7.5% and 4.4% of total area committed. Cloud service provider, large internet, and financial institution and enterprise customers accounted for 56.0%, 33.3% and 10.7% of total area committed.
quarterly_data.figure: two customers 29.0% and 12.0% of 2025 net revenue; two largest 37.9% and 11.8% of total area committed

quarterly_data.signal: Data center portfolio as of December 31, 2025 (20-F key performance indicators): area in service 668,283 sqm (613,583 sqm a year earlier), area under construction 73,994 sqm, total area committed 670,106 sqm, commitment rate 93.0%, pre-commitment rate 66.1%, area utilized 504,843 sqm and utilization rate 75.5% (73.8% a year earlier). Backlog (area committed or pre-committed but not yet utilized) was 165,263 sqm versus 176,904 sqm at end-2024; churn rate averaged approximately 0.9% in 2025 (1.2% in 2024).
quarterly_data.figure: area in service 668,283 sqm; utilization 75.5%; backlog 165,263 sqm

quarterly_data.signal: Facility specifications (20-F): self-developed capacity in service and under construction has an average power density of approximately 2.34 kW/sqm, with the portion under construction at approximately 2.97 kW/sqm and capacity held for future development at approximately 3.05 kW/sqm; approximately 90% of self-developed capacity in service and under construction is equipped with 2N redundant power delivery. In 2025 self-developed data centers that commenced operations after 2020 (IT power utilization rate of 30% or higher) achieved an average PUE of around 1.23.
quarterly_data.figure: power density ~2.34 kW/sqm (under construction ~2.97, future development ~3.05); PUE ~1.23

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results and capex (20-F): net revenue RMB 11,432,274 thousand (RMB 10,322,068 thousand in 2024), of which colocation services RMB 10,373,374 thousand; adjusted EBITDA RMB 5,403,462 thousand. Capital expenditures for continuing operations were RMB4,610.6 million (US$659.3 million) in 2025 versus RMB2,965.4 million in 2024, primarily for equipment, prepaid land use rights and leasehold improvement of data centers. Remaining performance obligations (excluding variable usage-based consideration) were RMB 3,758,033 thousand at December 31, 2025, of which RMB 1,206,233 thousand is expected within one year.
quarterly_data.figure: net revenue RMB 11,432,274 thousand; capex RMB4,610.6 million; RPO RMB 3,758,033 thousand
